text: With 10BBT out of service the plant runs from 20BBT. A GT start from 20BBT alone is possible only with the start-up auxiliary load limited to 5 MW besides the static frequency converter (short-time loading per IEC 60076-7, DEC-EPCE-0016); the load-flow and motor-starting study of section 16 confirms the limit, which is stated in the operating instructions.
